authority: Joseph 2026-08-25, DECISION-20260825-joseph-gate2-fail-and-four-rulings.md section 11.1.1: do NOT chmod the frozen deploy's .git; produce a git bundle plus a recorded sha256 instead, because the property the freeze lacks is DETECTABILITY, not resistance. Joseph 2026-08-26: require explicit HEAD inclusion and a list-heads postcondition proving the pinned commit present; emit no recovery receipt unless that postcondition passes.
CITABLE_FOR: That the frozen deploy's HEAD was aa67c426afaa9b6ca91c9996637a6bade950da9a and its ENTIRE ref set was the ten refs/tags/evidence/* rows below, as measured on 2026-08-26.
That a bundle exists from which the pinned commit and that ref set can be recovered WITHOUT access to any other repository, and that recovery was TESTED, not asserted.
That .git was NOT chmod'ed: measured drwxrwx--- after the ruling.
Detecting a LATER change to the pinned state, by re-running the recipe below and comparing against these values.
NOT_CITABLE_FOR: Any Gate-2 clause. Gate 2 remains FAIL.
A byte-image of the frozen clone's own object store -- see limitations.
Any claim that the frozen clone CANNOT be modified. It can: .git is writable, and this receipt makes a change DETECTABLE, not impossible.

verify_tail: The bundle uses this hash algorithm: sha1

postconditions.note: These are the gate Joseph required. A `--all` bundle would have FAILED them while exiting 0: that clone has NO branch and NO remote-tracking refs, so --all expands to the ten evidence tags alone, and `merge-base --is-ancestor aa67c426 <tag>` is FALSE for all ten -- a verifying, digestible bundle containing nothing to recover. The pin is therefore named EXPLICITLY via a local-only tag and asserted present afterwards.

tested_recovery.method: git clone --no-local <bundle> <tmp>  (--no-local forbids object sharing, so the bundle is the only source), then fsck, then checkout of the pin
tested_recovery.honest_limit_of_this_arm: recovered_tree matching the primary checkout's aa67c426^{tree} is NOT an independent confirmation -- both are the same git object. What this arm establishes is that the BUNDLE ALONE reconstructs a clean checkout at the pin. Independence comes from the separate measurement that the frozen clone's HEAD IS that commit.

limitations: The bundle was generated from the PRIMARY checkout, not from the frozen clone's own object store. Reason, measured: that clone has a LOOSE-object store on Lustre -- `git count-objects -vH` exceeded a 120 s timeout, and `git bundle create` there did not complete in 45 minutes and had to be killed. The primary checkout is fully packed (21597 objects, 1 pack, 80.81 MiB) and produced the bundle in seconds.

Consequence: this is a recovery source for the pinned COMMIT and the frozen clone's REF SET, not a byte-image of that clone's object store. The pinned STATE is identified by HEAD + ref set + commit content, and all three are recorded here.

Reading the frozen clone with git is NOT a read-only act (section 11.1 of the decision record): a git invocation there may write a lock into .git. This receipt's reads were rev-parse, show-ref and stat.

The freeze tag refs/tags/freeze/k0-aa67c426 is LOCAL ONLY and deliberately not pushed. It exists because `git bundle create` refuses a bare sha ('Refusing to create empty bundle'); a recovering party gets the ref from the bundle itself.
reverification_recipe: git -C /pscratch/sd/j/josephrb/k0r2/clean rev-parse HEAD   # must equal frozen_deploy.head
git -C /pscratch/sd/j/josephrb/k0r2/clean show-ref   # must equal frozen_deploy.refs, exactly ten rows and no others
git clone --no-local <bundle> <tmp> && git -C <tmp> checkout --detach freeze/k0-aa67c426 && git -C <tmp> status --porcelain   # must be empty
ANY mismatch is a finding, not a maintenance task: it means the pinned state moved.
